findings.name: stock-db

findings.fix: Raise the stock-db memory request/limit above what the stock-index load needs (e.g. to at least 128Mi or more based on observed usage); stock-api will stop crashing once the DB stays up.

diagnosis.summary: stock-api crashes because its database stock-db is unreachable. Root cause: stock-db's Deployment sets a 24Mi memory limit that its workload exceeds when loading the stock index, so the container is repeatedly OOMKilled (exit 137, 3 restarts, BackOff events) and never becomes ready. During each outage window stock-api logs 'stock-db:5432 unreachable' and exits fatally after 3 attempts, producing the reported restarts. Fixing the stock-db memory limit resolves both symptoms.
